log:
Public Log As String
Public Sink As Object
sink:
Public WithEvents App As Application
Private Sub App_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
Log = Log & "change:" & Sh.Name & "!" & Target.Address(False, False) & "|"
End Sub
Private Sub App_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
Log = Log & "calculate:" & Sh.Name & "|"
End Sub
Private Sub App_AfterCalculate()
Log = Log & "after|"
End Sub
watch:
Public Function Watch(how As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Object, s1 As Object, s2 As Object, made As New AfterSink
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set s1 = wb.Worksheets(1)
    s1.Name = "s1"
    Set s2 = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=s1)
    s2.Name = "s2"
    s1.Range("A1").Value = 1
    Select Case how
        Case 2, 5, 18, 22
            s1.Range("C1").Formula = "=RAND()"
        Case 4, 6, 10, 11, 13, 14, 16, 17, 19, 23
            s1.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        Case 20
            s2.Range("C1").Formula = "=RAND()"
            s1.Range("C1").Formula = "=RAND()"
        Case 21
            s2.Range("B1").Formula = "=s1!A1*2"
    End Select
    If how = 10 Or how = 11 Or how = 14 Then Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Set made.App = Application
    Set Sink = made
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Log = ""
    Select Case how
        Case 1, 2, 20
            Application.Calculate
        Case 3, 4, 5, 10, 21
            s1.Range("A1").Value = 5
        Case 6
            s1.Range("B1").Calculate
        Case 7, 22
            s1.Calculate
        Case 8
            Application.CalculateFull
        Case 9
            Application.CalculateFullRebuild
        Case 11
            s1.Range("A1").Value = 5
            Log = Log & "then|"
            Application.Calculate
        Case 12
            s1.Range("B1").Formula = "=1+1"
        Case 13
            s1.Range("A1").ClearContents
        Case 14
            s1.Range("A1").Value = 5
            Log = Log & "then|"
            Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Case 15
            s1.Range("A2").Value = 5
            s1.Range("A3").Value = 6
        Case 16
            s1.Range("A1").Value = 5
            s1.Range("A1").Value = 6
        Case 17
            s1.Range("A1:A3").Value = Array(7, 8, 9)
        Case 18
            s1.Range("A1").Calculate
        Case 19
            s1.Range("A1").Value = 1
        Case 23
            DoEvents
            s1.Range("A1").Value = 5
            DoEvents
    End Select
    Watch = Log & "end|"
End Function

Public Function Report() As String
    Report = Log
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Set Sink = Nothing
    Do While Workbooks.Count > 1
        Workbooks(Workbooks.Count).Close False
    Loop
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Log = ""
End Function
